recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length portrait of a man in an all-white ensemble leaning against a wall in a luxurious, Art Deco-inspired 1980s interior featuring mauve accents, a fluted black column, and architectural furniture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in bright white contrasting against muted beige and mauve tones
Verticality of the subject echoed by the fluted column and wall edge
Diagonal script typography balancing the top-left and bottom-left quadrants
Reflective surfaces in the background adding depth and geometric complexity
coreInvariants: Mauve/pink accent colors in decor and text
Soft, diffused studio lighting with minimal harsh shadows
1980s interior aesthetic with rounded furniture edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, full-body scale, leaning against a vertical wall edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the bright white of his shirt act as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the large script in the top left, down the vertical column, across to the subject's face, and finally to the secondary text in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the neutral-toned wall on the right and the carpeted floor.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white suit and the dark architectural elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Heavy drop shadow or thick outline to create depth
Ascenders and descenders are elongated and expressive
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature large, looping flourishes
Lowercase letters are compact and tightly kerned
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two distinct weights and styles of script; one bold and outlined, one thin and shadowed.
graphicDevices: Thick black outlines on primary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, professional lettering look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a stylish man with a mustache, wearing a white button-down shirt and white pleated trousers, leaning against a cream-colored wall. The background should be a 1980s luxury interior with a black fluted column, mauve-trimmed furniture, and a large mirror reflecting dried branches in a pink vase. Lighting should be soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold mauve script lettering with a black outline in the top left corner. Add a thinner, white script subtitle at a steep diagonal angle in the bottom left corner with a soft blue-grey drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the man wearing all white?
Is the primary text mauve with a black outline?
Is there a black fluted column in the background?
Is the secondary text angled diagonally?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Exact wording of the original titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white clothing doesn't blow out and retains fabric detail.
Verify the script text is legible despite the angles.
Check that the mauve color is consistent across the design.
Confirm the Art Deco revival elements (fluting, curves) are present.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key fashion portrait in a period-specific (80s) interior with dual-layered, expressive script typography in a pastel-and-black palette.
